label: Audit Committee Pack Generator
description: Assembles quarterly audit committee materials from audit findings, follow-up status, plan progress, and KRIs. Produces board-quality pack with executive summary and key metrics.

guidedInputs.label: Audits completed during the period
guidedInputs.description: List audits completed, their ratings, and headline findings.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., 1. KYC/CDD Review (Amber) — 4 findings (1 High, 2 Medium, 1 Low). 2. Payment Processing Controls (Green) — 1 finding (Low). 3. IT Change Management (Red) — 3 findings (1 Critical, 2 High)...

guidedInputs.label: Outstanding findings and remediation status
guidedInputs.description: Current status of all open findings across all audits. Include overdue items.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Total open: 18 (3 Critical, 6 High, 7 Medium, 2 Low). Overdue: 4 (2 Critical from IT audit Nov 2024, 2 High from CDD audit Sep 2024). On track: 14...

guidedInputs.label: Annual audit plan progress
guidedInputs.description: Progress against the approved annual audit plan.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., 8 of 24 planned audits completed (33%). On track for year-end. 2 audits deferred to Q3 due to regulatory examination priority. No unplanned audits added.

guidedInputs.label: Key Risk Indicators (if tracked)
guidedInputs.description: Paste KRI data or trends for the period.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Alert investigation SLA breach rate: 12% (amber threshold 10%). Customer complaint volumes: down 8% vs. prior quarter. EDD completion rate: 94% (green threshold 90%)...

guidedInputs.label: Chief Audit Executive key messages (optional)
guidedInputs.description: Any specific themes, concerns, or forward-looking commentary the CAE wants included.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Emerging concern about IT change management following Critical finding. Regulatory examination expected Q3 — two audits being reprioritised to support readiness...
